items.title: Google Deletes 3 ADK AI Workflows After Malicious GitHub Issue Could Trigger Privileged Agent
items.description: Google deleted three AI agent workflows from its Agent Development Kit (ADK) Python repository. Pillar Security showed that a public GitHub issue could manipulate a triage agent into triggering a privileged code-fixing agent.
